english.title: Fail to ensure gas stunner for pigs in premises other than slaughterhouse properly equipped and maintained
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the business operator]_
(B)_[a person]_

engaged in the stunning of pigs by exposure to gas in respect of premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed to ensure that

(C)_[the gas stunner was designed, constructed and maintained so as to avoid injury to a pig, avoid compression of the chest of a pig, enable a pig to remain upright until it lost consciousness and enable a pig to see other pigs as it is conveyed in the gas stunner]_
(D)_[adequate lighting was provided in the gas stunner and the conveying mechanism to allow pigs to see other pigs or their surroundings]_
(E)_[the gas stunner was equipped to maintain the gas concentration, as appropriate, in the gas stunner]_
(F)_[ there was a means of visually monitoring pigs which were in the gas stunner]_
(G)_[there was a means of flushing the gas stunner with atmospheric air with the minimum of delay]_
(H)_[there was a means of access to any pig with the minimum of delay]_
(I)_[the gas stunner was equipped with devices to measure and continuously display the gas concentration, as appropriate, in the gas stunner and give clearly visible and audible warning signals if the gas concentration fell below the required level]_
(J)_[no pig was passed through or allowed to remain in the gas stunner at any time when the visible and audible warning signals had been activated or when there was any defect in the operation of the gas stunner]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 40(3) of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
